notes: Safety Tracker v2.10.75 CLEAN. Fixes the Document Creation ON/OFF button. The safety_tracker_settings table is keyed by setting_key, but the previous frontend looked for a non-existent id field and therefore attempted to insert a duplicate document_creation_enabled setting, causing the safety_tracker_settings_pkey error. The toggle now updates the existing document_creation_enabled row by setting_key and only inserts it if it is genuinely missing. Existing documents and records are unchanged. All v2.10.74 register/download/calendar fixes remain unchanged.
